name: Swarm of Insects
classification: Medium swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing. Immune to charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, and stunned. Blindsight 10 ft. Passive Perception 8. No listed languages or skills.
appearance: A dense mass of Tiny insects with dark bodies and scattered winged forms.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, first printing (September 2014), p. 338. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/mm-2014
sections.Errata: Monster Manual errata v2.0 adds immunity to grappled for swarms on pp. 337–339.
sections.Traits: Swarm. Other creatures can share the swarm’s space, and it can share theirs. It can pass through any opening that admits a Tiny insect. The swarm cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm’s space. A hit deals 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) when the swarm has half its HP or fewer.

name: Swarm of Centipedes
classification: Medium swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing. Immune to charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, and stunned. Blindsight 10 ft. Passive Perception 8. No listed languages or skills.
appearance: A mass of amber-brown centipedes with long segmented bodies, fine antennae and many quick legs.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, first printing (September 2014), p. 338. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/mm-2014 Use the Swarm of Insects block with the sidebar’s Swarm of Centipedes variant.

sections.Actions: Bites. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm’s space. A hit deals 10 (4d4) piercing damage, or 5 (2d4) when the swarm has half its HP or fewer.
sections.Insect swarm variant: A creature this swarm reduces to 0 HP becomes stable and poisoned for 1 hour. The poison persists if the creature regains HP. The creature is paralyzed while poisoned by this effect.
